requiredReviewerArtifactContent: Qualified reviewer identity and appointment/independence evidence
Exact country, packVersion, source artifact hashes and fixture families
Actual reviewed/effective dates, decision, conditions and signature/attestation

validationLimits: This static gate does not authenticate reviewer qualification or cryptographically verify artifact signature. It hashes bytes and checks fields/statuses.
requiredApproval.reviewedAt/effectiveFrom are only checked as nonempty strings here; effectiveTo is not evaluated.
Fixture-family check tests length and membership but not uniqueness; authentic review must cover all four distinct families.
Qualifying CNPS does not authorize IRPP or production e-invoicing, which remain separately blocked.
